entries.zh: 脾胃火（脾胃有火，中医病证名：脾胃火热之症）
entries.en: fire (excess heat) of the spleen and stomach; a disorder of internal heat in Chinese medicine
strong, robust spleen and stomach; vigorous health

entries.zh: 拐（拐杖、手杖；词头直译「地狱之剑」，指拐杖形似剑）
entries.en: crutch, walking staff; lit. 'the sword of hell' as a fanciful name for a staff
entries.notes: 原稿闽南语栏含删改（sāy cuáy 及删除的 quiam cuay），词头'地狱之剑'为修士戏称，展开依赖推断故降中等。

entries.zh: （参见 Cordon 条）拐（釋拐：解释'拐'字；交叉引用条目）
entries.en: see under Cordon: gloss/explanation of kuai (staff, crutch); cross-reference entry
entries.notes: v. (vide) 交叉引用，原稿闽南语栏已删划且范围待核，故降中等。

entries.en: clapper of a bell; bell hammer

entries.zh: 糠朴（谷糠、粗糠及榨过的甘蔗渣等粗食糟粕）
entries.en: bran and husks, chaff; coarse food, pressed sugarcane lees and other rough fodder
entries.notes: 闽南语栏删改难辨（châpo 难辨），西语释义（榨蔗渣、糠粕）与汉字'糠朴'的对应依赖推断，故低置信。

entries.zh: 拗阴（汉字存疑：拗/执 之阴；具体所指不明，或与女性阴部/隐疾相关）
entries.en: 'aoy yin' — of doubtful sense, possibly a term for the female privy parts or an ailment; uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字栏标 [疑:拗/执]，词头 Bahague 释义不明，四栏无法互证，故低置信。

entries.en: to breathe hot air upon with the mouth; to exhale on, to huff
to blow hot breath; to breathe warm air on something
to go down, to descend, to lower, to drop

entries.zh: 落低（把它落下、放低到下面）
entries.en: to lower it down, to bring it down below
entries.notes: 原稿栏杂有西语 abajo 混写，官话对音 iochoh mo. lō tī 与汉字'落低'对应关系依赖推断，故降中等。

entries.zh: 落去叩（落下去叩；末字存疑：叩/叱，或为'落下去叱骂/叩问'之短语，尾字 îdg 义不明）
entries.en: to go down and knock/call upon (last character doubtful: knock or rebuke); tail syllable unclear
entries.notes: 汉字末字标 [疑:叩/叱]，原稿尾段 îdg 及官话 lŏ gūi nīn 均难以定夺，故低置信。
